caption:
Costa Rica's oldest mountain trails follow the natural lines of the ridges, built to avoid the deep mud of the valleys below. When you go mountain biking in Costa Rica along these high contours, the climb is rarely gradual; it is a direct negotiation between your legs and the earth. Up here, the air is cooler, the grass is wet with condensation, and the forest drops away on both sides to reveal how far you have actually climbed. There are no signs, no traffic, and no easy miles. Just the quiet click of a freehub and the space to catch your breath before the next rise.
